reason: I already reorder Toplux when it runs out and I have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I am not adding another one. $29.99 is more than I pay now and I have no reason to switch.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19), and I don't see what I'd get for the extra money that I'm not already getting.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what I pay now, around $20 a box, or a friend I trust telling me it helped her sleep better than what I take.
